description: A pure CALCULATION node — set a uniform wall thickness (and optionally an edge type) on every edge of a graph: graph in, graph out. Draws nothing on canvas.
instructions:
A value-only node: it takes a GRAPH as JSON and returns a graph as JSON with `thickness` (metres) set on EVERY edge to the parameter value. It has no geometry input or output and draws nothing on the canvas.

INPUT: graph takes { "nodes": [{ "id", "x", "y" }, ...], "edges": [{ "from_node_id", "to_node_id" }, ...] } — coordinates in metres, local to the anchor. Wire BSP / Graph Reduce val-graph into valin-graph.

OUTPUT: val-graph publishes the SAME graph (node ids + coordinates untouched) with every edge's `thickness` overwritten by the Thickness param. Wire it into another graph node, or into Merge Graph to combine graphs that carry different thicknesses.

EDGE TYPE: the optional Edge type param additionally stamps `type` on every edge — "wall", "door", "window" or "opening". Leave it on "(leave unchanged)" to keep whatever type the incoming edges already carry. This is what lets ONE merged graph distinguish its families: tag an exterior-wall graph at 0.23 m / "wall", an interior-wall graph at 0.1 m / "wall", a door graph at 0.1 m / "door" and a window graph at 0.23 m / "window", then Merge Graph unions all four with each edge keeping its own width and type. Note that Mitered Join and Graph to Matrix both SKIP `type: "opening"` edges, so use "door" / "window" (not "opening") when the openings should still be stroked.

Every parameter is wireable (valin-*).
